setup: Windows 11 laptop; Claude Code 2.1.295 headless (-p), effort medium, --permission-mode acceptEdits, read-only shell commands and the project test runner allowed; no package installs, no network, no web tools

scoring.easy: Hidden cases written from the maintainers' tests for the fix (cases_total per bug), run against the run's source changes only; tests_broken = newly failing tests in the project's own suite (for qs, counted against the fix, which itself changes 2 and 1 old assertions).
scoring.hard: The maintainers' test files from the fix commit: target cases = tests that fail before the fix and pass after it; tests_broken = tests in those files that pass both before and after the fix but fail with the run's change. Timing tests (quadratic, linear, perf, timing, redos) are not counted as broken.
scoring.cost: Claude Code's own total_cost_usd per run (API prices); runs were made on a subscription
